description: This file declares interfaces and configuration for encryption functions, potentially supporting multiple crypto libraries such as mbedtls, wolfSSL, and OpenSSL. It defines constants, typedefs, and function prototypes related to cryptographic operations.

methods.name: get_default_cipher
methods.description: Returns the default cipher used for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: get_cipher_or_print_error
methods.description: Retrieves a cipher by name and prints an error if not found.

methods.name: get_cipher_ivsize
methods.description: Returns the size of the initialization vector for a given cipher.

methods.name: get_cipher_keysize
methods.description: Returns the key size for a specified cipher.

methods.name: create_ctx
methods.description: Creates and initializes an encryption/decryption context.

methods.name: do_crypt
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption on input files using the provided context.

methods.name: free_ctx
methods.description: Frees and deallocates the cryptographic context.
